lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal saa(n)t sahaj laagaa prabh kee sev ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, in intuitive peace and poise; I have dedicated myself to serving God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਫਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan bahu bikaar saphal pooran taa ke kaam ||
lines.translation: One who meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord - his bonds are broken, all his sins are erased,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat mitee haumai chhutee simarat har ko naam ||
lines.translation: and his works are brought to perfect fruition; his evil-mindedness disappears, and his ego is subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran gahee paarabraham kee mitiaa aavaa gavan ||
lines.translation: Taking to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, his comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਵਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tariaa kuta(n)b siu gun gubi(n)d prabh ravan ||
lines.translation: He saves himself, along with his family, chanting the Praises of God, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee tahal kamaavanee japeeai prabh kaa naam ||
lines.translation: I serve the Lord, and I chant the Name of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore te paaiaa naanak sukh bisraam ||15||
lines.translation: From the Perfect Guru, Nanak has obtained peace and comfortable ease. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran kabahu na dolataa pooraa keeaa prabh aap ||
lines.translation: The perfect person never wavers; God Himself made him perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: din din chaRai savaaiaa naanak hot na ghaat ||16||
lines.translation: Day by day, he prospers; O Nanak, he shall not fail. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨਮਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooranamaa pooran prabh ek karan kaaran samarath ||
lines.translation: The day of the full moon: God alone is Perfect; He is the All-powerful Cause of causes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t daiaal purakh sabh oopar jaa kaa hath ||
lines.translation: The Lord is kind and compassionate to all beings and creatures; His Protecting Hand is over all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan gobi(n)d gur keeaa jaa kaa hoi ||
lines.translation: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Lord of the Universe; through the Guru, He acts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee prabh sujaan alakh nira(n)jan soi ||
lines.translation: God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is All-knowing, Unseen and Immaculately Pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham paramesaro sabh bidh jaananahaar ||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is the Knower of all ways and means.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee saran jog aath pahar namasakaar ||
lines.translation: He is the Support of His Saints, with the Power to give Sanctuary. Twenty-four hours a day, I bow in reverence to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: akath kathaa nah boojheeai simarahu har ke charan ||
lines.translation: His Unspoken Speech cannot be understood; I meditate on the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: patit udhaaran anaath naath naanak prabh kee saran ||16||
lines.translation: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Master of the masterless; Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh binase sahasaa gaio saran gahee har raai ||
lines.translation: My pain is gone, and my sorrows have departed, since I took to the Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: man chi(n)de phal paaiaa naanak har gun gaai ||17||
lines.translation: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai koee karai beechaar ||
lines.translation: Some sing, some listen, and some contemplate;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ko upadesai ko driRai tis kaa hoi udhaar ||
lines.translation: some preach, and some implant the Name within; this is how they are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh kaatai hoi niramalaa janam janam mal jaai ||
lines.translation: Their sinful mistakes are erased, and they become pure; the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat mukh oojalaa nah pohai tis maai ||
lines.translation: In this world and the next, their faces shall be radiant; they shall not be touched by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so surataa so baisano so giaanee dhanava(n)t ||
lines.translation: They are intuitively wise, and they are Vaishnaavs, worshippers of Vishnu; they are spiritually wise, wealthy and prosperous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sooraa kulava(n)t soi jin bhajiaa bhagava(n)t ||
lines.translation: They are spiritual heros, of noble birth, who vibrate upon the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: khatree braahaman sood bais udharai simar cha(n)daal ||
lines.translation: The Kh'shatriyas, the Brahmins, the low-caste Soodras, the Vaisha workers and the outcast pariahs are all saved,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: jin jaanio prabh aapanaa naanak tisahi ravaal ||17||
lines.translation: meditating on the Lord. Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who know his God. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee kee vaar mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Vaar In Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh daiaal hai jis no samat sabh koi ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is kind and compassionate; all are alike to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek drisat kar dekhadaa man bhaavanee te sidh hoi ||
lines.translation: He looks upon all impartially; with pure faith in the mind, He is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vich a(n)mrit hai har utam har pad soi ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar is within the True Guru; He is exalted and sublime, of Godly status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kirapaa te har dhiaaeeai guramukh paavai koi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, one meditates on the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain Him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maaiaa sabh bikh hai nit jag totaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Egotism and Maya are total poison; in these, people continually suffer loss in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa har dhan khatiaa guramukh sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh earns the profit of the wealth of the Lord's Name, contemplating the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mail bikh utarai har a(n)mrit har ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: The poisonous filth of egotism is removed, when one enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within the heart.
